name: auto-grid
title: Auto grid
description: As many equal columns as fit, counted by the grid itself.
use: A collection of like tiles that reflows with the room it is given and needs no query: cards, figures, panels. When the number of columns is part of the design, utilities alone are enough: grid grid-cols(3) with a container variant.

instead.when: The tiles stay on one row and a reader scrolls through them
A few tiles are larger than the rest on purpose
Each tile is as tall as what it holds, as in a gallery

classes.name: auto-grid
classes.description: Equal columns, as many as fit at --auto-grid-min or wider, with a 1rem gap. Empty columns keep their place

classes.name: auto-grid-fit
classes.description: Empty columns collapse, so the tiles that exist share the whole row

properties.name: --auto-grid-min
properties.description: The narrowest a column may be; a column is never wider than the grid itself
